contract: NSTextLayoutManager接NSRange仅用location；从textContentManager.documentRange.location偏移得到location再取fragment，任一级缺失返回CGRect.zero。textLineFragments首个unsigned NSLocationInRange匹配，否则重新取first line；无line返回.zero。signed location-line.characterRange.location保留overflow trap，先max0再min(length)；index<length取locationForCharacter(at:).x，否则typographicBounds.width。rect.x=characterX+glyphOrigin.x；y=layoutFragmentFrame.minY+glyphOrigin.y；width/height=整line typographicBounds。无fragment.minX、无caret固定宽度、无range.length。
